Horta — Barcelona, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

On 30 January 2026 a man was arrested after an attempted knife-point purse-snatching on the street. In July 2023 police dismantled a drug-dealing flat that supplied nearby beachgoers. A March 2021 article named local merchants among those reporting a post-pandemic rise in shoplifting. Together these point to a modest but real theft/robbery risk concentrated at night; no broader violent no-go-area pattern was found for the historic Horta core. Sources checked: barnadiario.com, 30 Jan 2026 / 12 Jul 2023; Metròpoli Obert, 24 Mar 2021.
